title: Solver report public release attestation
description: Binds a public-release privacy review to the exact transcript and screenshot evidence roots consumed by the report builder.

audience.description: Confirms that the reviewed output is approved for a public audience.

reviewedAt.description: Time at which the bound evidence was reviewed.

reviewer.description: Accountable reviewer or release process identity.

methods.description: Review methods used for transcripts and screenshots.

transcriptsContainNoSensitiveData.description: All published transcript text was reviewed for secrets and personal data.

screenshotsContainNoSensitiveData.description: Every screenshot hash in the bound root was visually reviewed for secrets and personal data.

customerIdentifiersExcluded.description: Customer names, codenames, and private identifiers are excluded.

publicTranscriptContentRootSha256.description: Canonical root hash of every public user and Agent message.

publicScreenshotContentRootSha256.description: Canonical root hash binding every reviewed screenshot path, digest, and dimension.

screenshotPrivacyValidationSha256.description: Canonical digest of the full-resolution OCR privacy validation bound to every public screenshot.

platformCommit.description: Platform commit that owns the historical evidence.

agentSkillVersion.description: Solver Agent Skill version that produced the historical evidence.

representativeStabilityPasses.description: Number of representative stability passes supported by the evidence.
